text: Matthew's body is recovering well — Whoop scored the night of Thursday, September 24 at 99 % — while his journal has been quiet for 6 days. I've asked him one thing: before he picks up the phone in the morning, notice whether he already felt rested. Whether the silence is tiredness or avoidance tells me more than any score.
